DF.generation: existing OpenFermion low_rank_two_body_decomposition; original indices retained
DF.prefix: first prefix covering >=50% ranking weight, with positive nonempty tail; structural rule only
DF.rank_policy: tol_only; actual rank recorded, never copied from H2 or historical H4

MC.event_audit: serialize the exact events returned by the production sampler before circuit generation, including position/order/component IDs and scalar/rotation phase, then join compiler price by immutable trajectory_id; no second sampling
MC.proposal_reason: fixed finite pilot cohort larger than H2; 256 is not justified as a rare-order or population-precision guarantee
MC.rare_orders: record law probabilities, observed positions, all per-trajectory event records; unobserved costs unknown
MC.seed_rule: sha256(NON_DF_H4_PILOT_V1/<representation>/<method>)[:8] little-endian; trajectory PCG64 order then components v2 unchanged
MC.uncertainty: existing paired covariance SE and nominal Student-t95 only

Pauli.prefix: first prefix covering >=50% nonidentity abs-coefficient sum, with positive nonempty tail; structural rule only

compiler.cost_scope: full Hadamard wrapper ordinary diag(I,U), phases and measurement; no preparation

evolution.law: existing finite_rte_even_paired; no new randomization or estimator
evolution.normalization: each actual involutory tail lambda; q*r log(B_K); identity/event phases preserved
evolution.proposal_reason: single smaller step than H2 for a larger system, no tuning or expected accuracy guarantee

execution.SOURCE: future clean implementation commit + all scientific code, runner, tests, contract, environment and user approval hashes
execution.activation: approval names exact SOURCE/contract digest/pack namespace; immutable grant and case claims; no automatic retry
execution.batch_approval: one explicit approval for the fully sealed H4 execution contract covers all listed stages; no per-stage confirmations

call_budget.case_evaluation: one sparse reference/mean and one cost loop per case; five precision projections, no refit
call_budget.case_numerical_evidence: one dense/sparse/Horner evidence evaluation per fixed case; frozen H2 path

execution.case_claims: fixed grant-specific claim directory and case_id with SOURCE/input/grant binding; changing run ID cannot refund a claim
execution.deduplication: share immutable hashed input files, per-case single adapter and cache for identical circuits; never drop repeated gates or change random draw order
execution.evidence: case SOURCE/input/grant, claim/marker, complete event logs, compiler counts and paired prices, stdout/stderr/exit, numerical gates, ledger, STOP; supervisor own descendants only
execution.input_binding: SCF/integral/DF/state receipts and hashes sealed before launching four cases; actual rank and prefix numbers resolved by frozen rules, no search
execution.new_namespace: must be chosen unused and sealed once before approved execution
execution.partial_failure: stop peer processes, persist pending/failed/complete states; do not retry any case or regenerate inputs
execution.resources: four fresh case interpreters; no shared Qiskit session; small dense BLAS avoids nested oversubscription; no CPU/RAM caps
execution.watchdog_semantics: no artificial compute deadline; future per-stage contracts may set measured deadlines or independent heartbeat; no thread heartbeat used to declare a busy compiler hung

fixed_candidates.PF: all terms/fragments; deterministic one-body also retained
fixed_candidates.PR: one structural prefix per representation; actual labels/indices/weights bound to input receipt before release
fixed_candidates.empty_tail_policy: STOP_SCOPE_NOT_SATISFIED; do not substitute PF or change prefix

gates: SCF convergence and orbital orthonormality; expected 4 spatial/8 spin dimensions
Pauli vs independent JW, DF full operator and existing DF physical-sector operator
common state norm/residual/energy, DF state crosscheck, independent PySCF FCI
dense/sparse reference, independent law mean and raw/normalization closure
forced order0/2/4 algebra checks separate from cost MC; first3 independent trajectories
ordinary controlled phases and all sampled cosine/sine compiled probabilities
per-axis C/N/G, exact rational mean identity, paired covariance SE, event log/price join

numerical.failure_policy: any technical gate failure stops run; ineligible precision row remains null without changing parameters

precision.ineligible_policy: N/G null with reason; do not lower allowance or change parameters to obtain eligibility
precision.large_dimension_caveat: the dense operation proxy may dominate tight precision rows; no guarantee of non-null H4 N/G
precision.numerical_allowance: same frozen empirical 64*eps operation proxy, safety10, floor1e-12, dense/sparse/Horner closure
precision.statistical_model: existing fresh IID corrected +/-1 Hoeffding sufficient N

missing_before_execution: one explicit adoption/batch approval bound to SOURCE/contract/namespace
automatic clean SOURCE/environment seal and fresh one-shot grant
readiness.permitted_now: artificial process and synthetic eight-qubit circuit tests; saved H2 read-only evidence only

state.method: full non-DF Nalpha=Nbeta=2 sector ground eigenvector; canonical largest amplitude positive real
state.reference: each representation own full-H at fixed T on the common non-DF state

system.identity: retained exactly once including nuclear phase
system.integrals: same unthresholded real orthonormal MO h, chemist eri for both representations; interleaved alpha/beta; spin lift and 1/2 exactly as frozen H2
